card.name: Separators in web menu and index lists
card.fires_on: Separator marks such as | or , between items in subject lists and menus, and a few name starts like Ch in José Luis Chilavert. Mostly general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A pipe or comma between category or keyword entries in site menus and subject headings.

modes.label: Start of a name

modes.label: Heading hyphens and words
modes.description: A hyphen or word inside a dated or classified index entry.

card.writes: No clear output effect beyond weakly promoting odd name and code pieces while suppressing the word clear.
card.plain: It fires on dividers between items in web lists and menus, and occasionally on the start of a surname.
